name: Mnemonic Type Classification
description: Branch, Jump and Return come from the type field in mnemonic.json. Only Jump and Return end a basic block, so only they may start a dead code region.

testCases.name: Jump - dead code after JMP
testCases.description: The instruction following an unconditional JMP is unreachable

testCases.name: Return - dead code after RTS
testCases.description: RTS has type Return and ends the block just like JMP

testCases.name: Return - dead code after RTI
testCases.description: RTI carries the same type as RTS

testCases.name: Branch - conditional branches keep the following code reachable
testCases.description: BEQ, BNE and BCC must not start a dead code region
